correctness.rationale: PRESET_FALLBACK exact criterion requires five artifacts; all independently re-verified with a fresh exact-rational implementation (not just re-running supplied scripts). (1) 3-uniform: all 14 listed triples have size 3 on V={0..8}, n=9<=10. (2) tau=4: claimed cover {0,4,7,8} hits all 14 edges (checked edge-by-edge); exhaustive enumeration of all C(9,3)=84 triples finds zero covers, so tau>=4; hence tau=4 exactly. (3) nu=1: C(14,2)=91 pairs, 25 disjoint; every disjoint pair has a third edge contained in the 6-vertex union (full 25-entry witness map re-checked: each witness edge subset of union), so no induced 2-matching; non-empty edge set gives nu=1. Witness map in DRAFT covers exactly the disjoint set. (4) reg lower bound: exact Fraction signed boundary ranks on W=511 (full set): 3-faces 57, r(d3)=42, r(d4)=14, so dim H~_3=57-42-14=1; on W=383: 33-26-6=1. Hence beta_{5,9}>=1 / beta_{4,8}>=1 in Hochster grading, reg>=4. (5) reg upper bound: exact-QQ scan of all 511 nonempty subsets finds max nonzero homology degree h=3, zero subsets with h>=4, so reg<=4; hence reg(S/I;Q)=4. Full exact Betti table recomputed and matches claimed table entry-for-entry {(1,2):14,(2,2):15,(2,3):27,(3,2):4,(3,3):47,(4,2):1,(4,3):24,(4,4):1,(5,3):3,(5,4):1}, max j=4. Proof vs evidence: tau/nu are exhaustive finite proofs; reg rests on Hochster's theorem (an equality giving exact Tor Betti numbers) plus exact Fraction ranks over Q -- a proof, not a mod-p proxy. Large-prime (1e9+7, 10007) and F2 replays agreeing at 4 are corroborating evidence only. Collage check: min 2-collage size 5 independently recomputed (cap 10), claimed 5-set {e1,e3,e4,e5,e14} verified valid, so reg=4 is strictly interior. H0 strand correctly absent (all 2-subsets are faces, 1-skeleton complete). The stated limitation (no explicit minimal differentials) does not weaken the claim because Hochster's formula is exact. Note: DRAFT.md mislabels mask 383 as {0,1,2,3,4,5,7,8} (mask 447, which carries no H~_3); the correct vertex set for mask 383 is {0,1,2,3,4,5,6,8}, verified dim H~_3=1 (33-26-6=1). The mask itself and H1_cert.json witQ entry (383,3,1) are correct, and W=511 alone suffices for reg>=4, so the headline is unaffected; RESULT.md records the corrected set.
